meta.title: JEE Advanced coaching in Pune | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE Advanced coaching with Advanced-level problem sets, quarterly Advanced mocks in Class 12 and one-on-one mentoring with Kota faculty.

intro: JEE Advanced is the exam for admission to the IITs. Only students who do well enough in JEE Main can sit it.

sections.heading: How JEE Advanced is different
body: There are {{fact:exam.jee-advanced#papers}} papers of {{fact:exam.jee-advanced#hoursEach}} hours each, on the same day. The kinds of questions and the marking change from year to year, so practice has to cover more than one kind of question.

sections.heading: How we prepare students for it

body.text: The two-year programme prepares for JEE Advanced alongside JEE Main, from the start.

points.text: Problem sets at JEE Advanced level for every chapter.
A JEE Advanced mock every quarter in Class 12.
One-on-one mentoring slots for the hardest problems.

questions.q: Does every student prepare for JEE Advanced?

a.text: In the two-year programme, yes. Preparing for it also helps in JEE Main.

questions.q: Where can I read the official rules?
questions.a: In the JEE Advanced information brochure, published each year by the IIT that runs the exam.
